info.title: Kuestenlogik.Surgewave.Benchmarks.PublicTool
info.description: Surgewave Public Benchmark — reproducible G3 throughput + latency runs across Surgewave Native, Surgewave Kafka-wire, Apache Kafka and Redpanda. Install with `dotnet tool install -g Kuestenlogik.Surgewave.Benchmarks` and run with `surgewave-bench public --output results.md`. Standalone tool — intentionally NOT a subcommand of the main `surgewave` CLI so Testcontainers + Confluent.Kafka do not bleed into the broker/operator binary (plugin-first architecture).

commands.name: public
commands.description: Run the curated G3 public benchmark suite.

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to write the Markdown report. Default: stdout.

options.name: --json
options.description: Path to write the JSON sidecar (for --compare). Default: skip JSON.

options.name: --compare
options.description: Reference JSON file to diff against — adds a Δ% table to the report.

options.name: --compression
options.description: Compression codec (none, gzip, snappy, lz4, zstd). [default: lz4]
